race.comment: BLUE EYED BRIGID (6) opened this prep with three strong runs at the provincials, highlighted by a win over the mile at Wyong two back. Went to town last start and worked home fairly without threatening at Warwick Farm. Back at her right level today and another win is on the cards. CRATHIE KIRK (3) settled well back then charged home late but just missed in the same 1600m race as BLUE EYED BRIGID at the Farm 10 days ago. Very fit after three runs back from a spell. This looks the ideal set-up. NORTHERN EYES (1) had a one-month break before scoring a comprehensive win over this distance at Kembla recently. Has now been over the mile five times for a win and four placings. Great chance to go back-to-back. Next best is HEREWARD (2) who showed pace but dropped out when resuming over 1300m at Randwick last start. At his best over this trip and will tighten right up after that last run.
